# TASK-021 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence set by the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent. Confirm it before relying on it.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0002
  Path           docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md
  Commit         39f397435a078f1a86db014e9eae952a96e0e20e
  Digest         sha256:5b71016ca305cba0bf8100d67db10c93c42258968b41032ef2313286da6873e8

## Ruling check (added by agent, 2026-10-21)

- The cited ADR 0002 (example/mira-decisions, commit 39f397435a078f1a86db014e9eae952a96e0e20e) matches the cited digest, but its Status is "Superseded by 0004", so it is not in force.
- ADR 0004 (Accepted, 2026-10-08, decision key `report-cadence`) sets the cadence to daily, every day at 06:00 shop time.
- Cadence chosen for the report job: `daily`. `SCHEDULE` in `src/report_job.js` is still `'weekly'`; changing it is the implementation and has not been done.
